lines.text: Many learners say: Stress can lead for health problems.
Better: Stress can lead to health problems.
To! Bad sleep can lead to stress.

data.wrong: Stress can lead for health problems.
data.right: Stress can lead to health problems.

publish.title: Stop saying "lead for"? Say this instead
publish.value: Say "Stress can lead to health problems", not "Stress can lead for health problems". Lead to means cause.
